Shipped by `agent-liveness-heartbeat-hardening-2026-06-12` (after the
stale-claims sweep and EI-348). This page is the one mental model; the
per-module docs live in the source headers it links.

## The four signals, robustness-ordered

| # | Signal | Written by | Semantics | Covers a long no-tool-call turn? |
|---|--------|-----------|-----------|------------------|
| 1 | **Supervision heartbeat** — `spawned_agents.heartbeat_at` | The host that OWNS the process: the operator's nursery loop (`fleet/operator-spawn.ts ensureSpawnHeartbeatLoop`) for cups; the psu launcher's supervisor beat (`scripts/psu-launcher.mjs startSupervisorBeat` → the bootstrap-su heartbeat endpoint) for interactive sessions | "I hold this process handle and it is alive" | **Yes** |
| 2 | **Stream activity** — `spawned_agents.last_output_at` (cups, mig 233) · pty discovery-file `lastOutputAt` (psu pty sessions) | The runner's in-process stdout/stderr listeners (`dbos/orchestrator-runner.ts onOutputActivity`); the pty host's activity tracker (`scripts/psu-pty-host.mjs makeActivityTracker`) | "The agent emitted bytes just now" — *generating*, not merely alive | Yes, and it distinguishes generating from wedged |
| 3 | **Dispatch beat** — `coord_presence.last_active_at` AND `.heartbeat_at` via `touchActivity` | The projected-tool dispatch seam (`projected-tool-deps.ts recordInvocationImpl` → `agent-tools/coordination/dispatch-heartbeat.ts`), throttled per owner | "The agent made ANY platform tool call recently" — the per-edit lock hook traffic alone keeps an actively-editing session warm | No (but such turns also make no edits) |
| 4 | **Coord beat** — `coord_presence.heartbeat_at` | `coord:declare-intent`, `coord:inbox` reads | "The agent touched the coordination layer recently" | No |

A projected dispatch IS genuine activity, so leg 3 beats via `touchActivity`
(bumps `last_active_at` *and* `heartbeat_at`, presence-v2 D-003) — distinct from
the pure keepalive `touchHeartbeat` (leg 1's 60s supervisor beat) which bumps
`heartbeat_at` only. Both are no-ops when no presence row exists, so one-shot
HTTP callers never mint roster rows.

Two invariants:

- **A signal is written by whoever can actually observe it.** The sweep/roster
  never `kill -0`s processes: it's same-host-only, session agents have no PID
  (`coord_presence.pid` is null for HTTP MCP clients), and alive ≠ progressing —
  a wedged process passes `kill -0` forever. Supervision heartbeats ARE
  process-prodding, done by the process-owner and projected into PG where every
  host can read them.
- **Annotate, don't suppress** (plan D-002) — for the badge and for attended /
  non-cup sessions: stream-activity staleness flags a `possibly_wedged`
  candidate for humans/the Mug (`fleet:tree`, `isPossiblyWedged` in
  `fleet/spawn-reclaim.ts`) without feeding claim release, so an
  attended-but-quiet session keeps its claims. **The exception is a supervised
  local cup under the now-shipped wedge auto-reaper** (D-006, flag
  `WEDGE_AUTO_REAP` default ON): a cup whose stream is silent past 30min IS
  reaped — `reapWedgedLocalSpawns` (`fleet/operator-spawn.ts`) durably cancels it
  via `cancelSubtree`, which DOES release its work-item and plan-item claims
  (`claimsReleased` / `planClaimsReleased` in `fleet/nursery.ts`) before the
  local abort. For a wedged cup, then, stream-activity staleness (leg 2) feeds
  claim release; absence of any observed output is still never treated as a
  wedge.

## Which consumers read which legs

| Consumer | Legs read | Where |
|----------|----------|-------|
| Stale-claims sweep (releases `taken_by` of dead holders) | 1 + 3/4 (presence OR nursery, alias-aware per mig 225) | `work-items-stale-claims.ts` |
| Spawn reclaim (frees ceiling slots of dead-host spawns) | 1, plus same-host pid-alive as a keep-alive override (EI-85) | `fleet/spawn-reclaim.ts` |
| Colony roster / Sessions view | best of 1 (nursery join, pid-alive definitive) and 3/4 (presence) — EI-348 | `adv-roster.ts mergeRosterEntries` |
| Wedge badge (`possibly_wedged`) | 1 fresh AND 2 stale | `fleet:tree` → `isPossiblyWedged` |
| Wedge auto-reaper (cancels + releases claims of supervised cups silent past threshold) | 1 fresh AND 2 stale | `fleet/operator-spawn.ts reapWedgedLocalSpawns` (flag `WEDGE_AUTO_REAP`, default ON) |

**The rule for new consumers: read the strongest leg available for the agent
class, not just presence.** EI-348 was exactly a consumer reading only leg 3/4
for agents whose truth lived in leg 1.

For cups, legs 1 and 2 are not two independent timers: the nursery heartbeat
loop (`ensureSpawnHeartbeatLoop`) is one tick on `SPAWN_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_MS`
that (a) bumps `heartbeat_at`, (b) write-throughs `last_output_at` for streams
that moved since the last persist (`GREATEST`-monotonic, P-008 — zero extra
write cadence), and (c) runs the wedge auto-reaper. The runner's
`onOutputActivity` only records the in-process stream timestamp; this tick is
what persists it.

## The supervisability boundary

Processes our infrastructure launches are fully supervisable: fleet cups
(operator children) and psu sessions (the launcher stays parent in both the
plain and managed-pty paths; the pty host additionally sees every byte). The
remainder — a bare `claude` launched outside psu, remote claude.ai/code
sessions, desktop embedded chat — can only be observed through their platform
traffic (legs 3/4). That is why the dispatch beat exists and ships enabled.

## Tuning knobs

- `DISPATCH_BEAT_INTERVAL_MS` (45s) — `dispatch-heartbeat.ts`
- `SUPERVISOR_BEAT_MS` (60s) — `psu-launcher.mjs`
- `SPAWN_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_MS` (60s) — `fleet/spawn-reclaim.ts`
- `ACTIVITY_PERSIST_MS` (15s, pty discovery write-through) — `psu-pty-host.mjs`
- `WEDGE_SILENT_MS` (10min, badge threshold) — `fleet/spawn-reclaim.ts`
- `WEDGE_REAP_SILENT_MS` (30min, env `PAPERCUSP_WEDGE_REAP_MS`, reaper threshold —
  distinct from and longer than the badge's) — `fleet/operator-spawn.ts`
- `WEDGE_AUTO_REAP` flag (default ON, D-006) — `libs/flags/src/types.ts`
- Liveness windows: `LIVE_MS` 60s / `STALE_MS` 10min (`liveness.ts`) ·
  claim-sweep grace `STALE_CLAIM_GRACE_MS` 10min (`work-items-stale-claims.ts`)
